summary: Grupo Simec filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, disclosing that it was unable to timely file its annual Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 due to ongoing procedures and analyses of internal controls and financial statements. The company is in contact with NYSE regarding listing standards and cure procedures. This is a routine late-filing disclosure with no special-situation event like a going-private, tender, or activist campaign.
